Q: Thank you for taking the time to speak with me today. This recording is for claim review purposes. Can you plaese
state your full name for the record?
A: I'd rather not give my full name on a recording, but you already have it on the claim file. Go ahead.
Q: That's fine. Can you walk me through what happened at the intersection in Houston?
A: I was going through a green light heading north. A car coming from the cross street didn't stop and hit the driver's
side of my vehicle.
Q: Did you see the other vehicle before the impact?
A: Not really. It came out of nowhere. I heard the horn and then there was a loud bang.
Q: Were you able to drive your vehicle from the scene?
A: No. The front was pushed in and the airbags went off. A tow truck took it away.
Q: Did you get any medical attention after the collision?
A: An ambulance took me to the hospital. They X-rayed my knee and told me it was badly bruised and possibly torn.
I've been on crutches since then.
Q: Have you seen a doctor since discharge?
A: Yes, I've had two follow-up visits with an orthopedic doctor. They want me to do physical therapy three times a
week.
Q: Had you ever injured that knee before?
A: Years ago I twisted it playing soccer, but it had fully healed and I hadn't had any trouble with it in a long time.
Q: Is there anything else you think I should know about the accident?
A: Only that I was following the traffic rules and I'm still struggling to get back to work because of this knee.
Q: Thank you. We'll follow up in writing once we've reviewed the information.
A: Okay, thanks.
</page>
